description: Calculate the illustrative annualized USD earnings difference between two savings APYs for a given balance and horizon (years). Defaults: current_apy_percent = FDIC national average savings rate, comparison_apy_percent = highest RateZip-observed savings APY. Returns rounded USD amounts (current_end_balance, comparison_end_balance, earnings_difference = comparison_end_balance - current_end_balance; positive when comparison_apy_percent > current_apy_percent, negative when lower), explicit omissions (taxes, penalties, rate changes, tiers, availability), and provenance for defaulted rates. Use when the caller wants the dollar yield gap between two APYs; use get_savings_rates or compare_deposit_options to browse or filter institution rates first. Illustrative calculation only; not financial advice.

comparison_apy_percent.description: APY to compare against (%); defaults to the highest RateZip-observed savings APY

current_apy_percent.description: APY the money earns today (%); defaults to the FDIC national average savings rate

name: calculate_deposit_earnings_difference

comparison_end_balance.description: Ending balance in USD rounded to cents at comparison_apy_percent.

current_end_balance.description: Ending balance in USD rounded to cents at current_apy_percent.

defaults_used.description: Sources used when current_apy_percent or comparison_apy_percent defaulted.

earnings_difference.description: USD difference rounded to cents: comparison_end_balance minus current_end_balance (positive when comparison_apy_percent > current_apy_percent; negative when lower).

framing.description: Required framing phrase ('illustrative annualized earnings difference').

input_provenance.description: Per-default observation timestamps, snapshot IDs, and staleness.

inputs.description: Resolved calculation inputs (balance, current_apy_percent, comparison_apy_percent, years).

omissions.description: Material factors omitted from the calculation (taxes, penalties, rate changes, tiers, availability).

title: Illustrative deposit earnings difference
